certifications.name: Atrium Medical Center - Certificate of Recognition for outstanding performance

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents as a seasoned professional in the field of hospital marketing, demonstrating strong interpersonal and communication skills. With experience spanning over four years as Director of Business Development, the candidate has successfully managed a team to enhance market presence and census growth within long term acute care hospitals (LTAC). The ability to develop strategic partnerships with physicians and healthcare community members is evident from achievements such as opening new referral sources and implementing effective marketing strategies for increased admissions. Educational background in interdisciplinary studies provides a well-rounded perspective that supports the candidate's holistic approach towards patient needs and market demands.
